meta.name: get-unpublished-changes
meta.description: Compare HEAD with the latest published npm versions and list all unpublished changes by release layer. Triggers: unpublished changes, changelog, what changed, whats new.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 对比本地代码与已发布版本，列出未发布的变更
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要知道哪些代码改动还没发布到npm
copy.tagline_en: Compare local code with published npm versions and list unpublished changes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to know which code changes are not yet published to npm

howto.what: 当你询问未发布的变化时，Claude会对比当前代码与最新发布的npm版本，按组件层列出所有未发布的改动、修复和重构。
howto.when: 当你提到“unpublished changes”、“changelog”、“what changed”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 看看有什么未发布的改动。
say.note: Claude会列出所有尚未发布的变更。
Claude会生成按层分类的变更列表。

say.text: 有什么新东西还没发布？
say.note: Claude会对比当前代码与最新版本。

howto.what_en: When you ask about unpublished changes, Claude compares the current codebase with the latest published npm versions and lists all unpushed changes categorized by release layers (pure components, opencode, codex).
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention "unpublished changes", "changelog", "what changed", or "whats new".

say_en.note: Claude will list all unpushed changes.
Claude will generate a layer-by-layer list.

say_en.text: What's new that hasn't been released?
say_en.note: Claude will diff against the latest version.
